1018-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2893-3470-6763-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2105-4598-6633-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-6633-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-6633-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2079-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-997-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

654-3227-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-3227-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-3227-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scrivener and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

539-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
539-3800-4687.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4022-4247-4772-5926.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

1170-5131-6595-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6595-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

654-851-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-851-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7934.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1251-1409-3099-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

470-1560-4050-6270.notablePrerequisites: The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
470-1560-4050-6270.description:
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G/P}.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve Ghalta. When it enters, Vaultborn Tyrant triggers, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghalta, adding {G}. Choose to return Ghalta from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3756-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3756-4231-4365.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4907-6709-6989.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn

1621-4605-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 3.

5413-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-3755-5223-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-5223-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is at least level 2 is level 3

5078-5849-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
5078-5849-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Five Hundred Year Diary

1978-4832-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-4832-5527.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat

2034-2178-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
2034-2178-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Arbor Adherent trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Arbor Adherent trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2018-4053-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-4053-6294.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

1580-2060-5147-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-5147-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

913-4131-4222-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-4853-5315-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5315-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

719-1429-2981-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-2981-5402.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2538-3139-3652-3676.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

804-1479-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2478-3200-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
2478-3200-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

2178-3143-3490-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3143-3490-5296.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
If you control another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, you will get infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, and you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

1416-2178-4102.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1416-2178-4102.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1018-2564-4231-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand, and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

232-2136-3750.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
232-2136-3750.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrasks enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding fifteen {R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

185-1980-2104-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on each odd-numbered turn, with at most {3}{U} available each even-numbered turn
185-1980-2104-3098.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast etiher Mystic Retrieval or Call to Mind by paying its mana cost, targeting either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval in your graveyard.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve both Call to Minds or Mystic Retrievals, returning Temporal Manipulation and either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

654-2893-3430-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2893-3430-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

803-1486-3457.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-3457.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
